| Package | Component | Pinned version | What we use it for | Why pinned / known breakage on upgrade |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `mistralai-workflows` | backend (optional) | unpinned (3.4.0 tested) | Compiled workflows and the Temporal worker | Installed separately; its activity registry is global, so one process per key is needed |
| `fastapi[standard]`, `uvicorn[standard]` | backend, Tool Service | unpinned (0.136.1 / 0.46.0 tested) | HTTP | none known |
| `pydantic-settings`, `pydantic` | both | unpinned (2.14 / 2.13 tested) | Settings and every spec model | Pydantic v2 APIs are assumed throughout (`model_dump`, `model_validate`) |
| `sqlalchemy` | both | unpinned (2.0.49 tested) | ORM and raw SQL | 2.0 style; the `do_orm_execute` and `with_loader_criteria` events are used by workspace scoping |
| `argon2-cffi` | backend | `>=23.1` (25.1.0) | Password hashing | none |
| `jsonschema` | both | `>=4.20` (4.26.0) | Spec preflight, process document and input validation | Needs Draft 2020-12 support |
| `paramiko` | backend | unpinned (5.0.0) | SSH and SFTP to remote servers; also brings `cryptography` | none |
| `cryptography` | backend | unpinned (48.0.0); **not in requirements.txt** (installed explicitly in the Dockerfile) | Fernet for the vault, workspace keys and remote-server secrets | It must be installed. Locally it arrives through paramiko. |
| `neo4j` | backend | unpinned (6.2.0 driver) | Graph store | The driver talks to Neo4j 5 servers |
| `watchfiles` | backend | unpinned (1.1.1) | Worker hot reload on compiled-workflow changes | Without it, hot reload is off (warning only) |
| `httpx` | both | unpinned (0.28.1) | Tool Service client, Mistral REST calls, cleanup | none |
| `ruff` | Tool Service | unpinned | Static analysis rung of the verification ladder | Its rule output is parsed; a big upgrade may change messages |
| `requests`, `pandas`, `numpy`, `beautifulsoup4`, `lxml` | Tool Service sandbox (`sandbox_requirements.txt`) | unpinned | The libraries generated code may import (`policy.ALLOWED_THIRD_PARTY`) | Keep in step with the allow-list. `sqlalchemy` is listed but forbidden to generated code. |

| `react` 19.2, `@tanstack/react-query` 5.101, `zustand` 5, `axios` 1.19, `@xyflow/react` 12, `tailwindcss` 4.2, Radix primitives, `gsap` 3.15.0 | frontend-3 | caret, except gsap (exact) | UI, data fetching, state, HTTP, graph canvas, styling, animation | Tailwind v4 config is CSS-first (`src/styles.css`), not `tailwind.config.js` |

## Lock files
- **`frontend-3/bun.lock`** (bun). Identical install: `cd frontend-3 && bun install --frozen-lockfile`. The Dockerfile uses a non-frozen `bun install`, so images can drift.
- **`frontend/package-lock.json`** (npm) for the legacy SPA only: `npm ci` in `frontend/`.
- **Python has no lock file.** `backend/requirements.txt` and `tool-service/requirements.txt` are mostly unpinned. To reproduce the tested set, pin to the versions in the table above (`pip install "mistralai[telemetry]==2.8.0" "fastapi==0.136.1" …`), or freeze from a working venv with `pip freeze > requirements.lock`.

## Vendored or patched code
- **None vendored.**
- **Copied code that must be kept in step by hand:** `backend/app/app_settings/core.py` ↔ `tool-service/app/runtime_config.py`. They have drifted (the backend has an extra `json` setting type).
- **`frontend-3/src/components/ui/*`** are shadcn/ui primitives copied into the repo (new-york style). Only `button.tsx` (custom variants) and `sheet.tsx` (resizable) differ from stock.
- **No monkey patches.**
